title: Aoyagi Toya — Shared Admiration〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It was nice to see him doing well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He even said that Tono has been visiting him in the hospital every day, so they may return to being Gurney flap soon.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, now I need to...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya & Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hello, Yoisaki.
We haven't seen each other since Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
It's nice to see you again, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... Are you about to head somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm on my way back from visiting a friend at the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, the hospital?
The one on top of the hill?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, the one over that way, with the rehabilitation center.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you don't mind me asking, does this mean you're about to go visit someone, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'm visiting my da... Also a friend.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
I've been meaning to ask you a question, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your last name sounded so familiar for some reason. It's not an uncommon name, but I had to wonder...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does your father happen to be Harumichi Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, he is...
I didn't realize you were familiar.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He is a world-renowned musician.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He also does quite a lot of concerts, yes? I haven't had a chance to see him perform yet, but I do have some of his CDs at my house.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He's such an incredible person. He has such a talent for capturing the feelings and emotions that go into a song through his performances.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've gotten goosebumps while listening to his CDs, so he must sound even more astounding live.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the way his music resonates throughout a hall is simply unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I might try getting some tickets for his next concert.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, Aoyagi, you write the songs for your team, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Not all of them.
But we did perform the ones I wrote during the event we hosted the other day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've never tried composing a street-genre song, but sampling different sounds seems very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've just started to get the hang of writing songs after being taught how. Now, I'm having quite a lot of fun. I learn something new every time I do it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Maybe I should also give it a try.
Especially if I can learn some new tricks and broaden my horizons as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you'd like, I can teach you how the process works.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In return, you can show me how you compose.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've only just started to learn how to use digital tools, so I'm wondering which plug-ins and such would work best for the feelings I'd like to express...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's hard not to get lost in all the free plug-ins that are available out there. I still have trouble choosing from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?
se_walk_women_001_2
Huh...? Hey, Kanade, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's super rare to see you two together like this! Wait, now I remember! You got to talk a lot during Shibuya Instrument Day, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we just ran into each other, so we were catching up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're in your regular clothes, Akiyama. Do you not have supplementary classes today?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nope, I just got off work♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that my shift's over, I'm headed over to the diner to wait for the others.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait for the others...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We're having our after-party there with Mafuyu and Ena.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
I apologize for taking up so much of your time. I didn't realize that you had plans.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay. We aren't meeting for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you guys should keep chatting.
I can even head over first to let them know that you're running a little late, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, you have a prior engagement. I shouldn't keep you any longer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'd like to sit down and talk more about composing sometime with you, Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to ask you more about your music as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll see you again at school, Akiyama.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye bye♪ See you later!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Yoisaki's apparently composed quite a few songs, so I'm looking forward to talking with her again.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should learn more about songwriting and composing before next time, to make sure we get to have a meaningful discussion.)
